question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: The meditation is to be performed in place after place.
The object meditated upon extends from Shiva down to Avici.
The scope of meditation spans the entire cosmic range.
inference: The meditator must contemplate that object in every locus as pervading all levels from Shiva to Avici.
